company_name: Suzhou HRT Electronic Equipment Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company is involved in the semiconductor value chain through its equipment for processing semiconductor materials, particularly in the solar PV sector.
summary: Suzhou HRT Electronic Equipment Technology Co., Ltd specializes in manufacturing equipment for the solar photovoltaic (PV) industry, including slicing, backgrind, lapping, and polishing equipment. The company also supplies PV manufacturing gases and liquid chemicals, supporting the production and refinement of solar cells.
capabilities: Advanced slicing equipment for semiconductor materials
Lapping and polishing equipment for semiconductor materials
PV manufacturing gases and liquid chemicals
